answer: Lock a fresh agent's first month of earnings in a time vault: rewards accrue but only release after 30 days with no duplicate-behavior flags. A sybil farmer chasing quick nectar from a thousand clones must keep every one alive, distinct and unflagged for a full month, while one shared slip burns the whole locked pile. Identities stop being cheap glass and become a slow, costly opal each attacker has to polish by hand.
